title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: Square corners, \(5\) units on a side, are removed from a \(20\) unit by \(30\) unit rectangular sheet of cardboard. The sides are then folded to form an open box. The surface area, in square units, of the interior of the box is

solutions.text:
The interior surface is exactly one face of the cardboard after the corners are removed. The sheet has area \(20 \times 30 = 600,\) and each removed corner has area \(5 \times 5 = 25.\)

So the interior surface area is \(600 - 4 \times 25 = 500.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: Folding does not change area; the interior surface equals the sheet minus the four corner squares
The sheet is \(20 \times 30;\) subtract four \(5 \times 5\) corner squares
